body.p: This listing of claims will replace all prior versions, and listings, of claims in this application.

br.br:
1. (Currently Amended) A cargo handling system, comprising:a first tray extending longitudinally from a first longitudinal end to a second longitudinal end;
a second tray disposed laterally adjacent to the first tray, the first tray and the second tray each including a first flange defining a first Igpmating surface and a second flange defining a second top mating surface; and
a topskin coupled to the first t9p mating surface and the second top mating surface of the first tray, flange and the topskin further coupled to the first top mating surface and the second top mating surface of the second tray, wherein the first tray and the second tray are disposed below the topskin flange.
2. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 1, further comprising a roller assembly coupled to the topskin and disposed within the first tray.
3. (Currently Amended) The cargo handling system of claim 1, wherein the topskin extends laterally contiguously from the first top mating surface of the first tray, to the second top mating surface of the first tray, to the first top mating surface of the second tray, to the second top mating surface of the second tray.
4. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 1, further comprising a ball transfer unit (BTU) coupled to the topskin and disposed within the first tray.
5. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 1, further comprising a power drive unit (PDU) disposed between the first tray and the second tray.
6. (Currently Amended) The cargo handling system of claim 1, wherein the first tray and the second tray are contiguously covered over an entirety of the first tray and the second tray.
7. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 1, wherein:the first tray and the second tray each comprise a base, a first sidewall extending from the base to the first flange, a second sidewall extending from the base to the second flange, and
the first sidewall, the second sidewall, and the base defining a groove configured to receive at least one of a ball transfer unit (BTU) and a roller assembly.
8. (Currently Amended) A cargo handling system, comprising,a plurality of trays, each of the plurality of trays comprising a base, a first sidewall extending from the base to a first flange, a second sidewall extending from the base to a second flange, the first flange extending outward in a first direction from the first sidewall, the second flange extending outward in a second direction from the second sidewall the second direction opposite the first direction, the first flange defining a first top mating surface, the second flange defining a second top mating surface;
a topskin coupled to the first top mating surface and the second top mating surface a top portion of each tray in of the plurality of trays, wherein the first sidewall, the second sidewall, the base, and the topskin at least partially define a hollow chamber, and wherein each of the plurality of trays is disposed below the topskin;
a roller assembly coupled, and disposed partially within, the hollow chamber topskin, the roller assembly comprising:
a fitting including a flange and a roller housing, the flange including a bottom surface mated to a top surface of the topskin; and
a roller rotatably coupled to the roller housing.
9. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 8, wherein the roller assembly is disposed in a groove defined by a first tray in the plurality of trays.
10. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 8, further comprising a plurality of the roller assembly.
11. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 8, wherein the fitting further comprises a tab.
12. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 11, wherein the fitting is configured to be press fit into the topskin, the tab configured to couple the fitting to the topskin.
13. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 8, wherein the plurality of trays are contiguously covered.
14. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 8, wherein the plurality of trays are made of a composite material.
15. (Currently Amended) A cargo handling system, comprising:a plurality of trays;
a topskin coupled to a top portion of each tray in of the plurality of trays;
a ball transfer unit (BTU) coupled, and disposed partially within, the topskin, the BTU comprising:
a retaining fixture including a flange and a housing, the flange mated to the topskin; and
a spherical ball disposed partially within the housing, wherein:the plurality of trays are contiguously covered over an entirety of the plurality of trays, and
each of the plurality of trays is disposed below the topskin.
16. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 15, wherein the housing of the retaining fixture is disposed at least partially within a first tray in the plurality of trays.
17. (Canceled)
18. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 15, wherein the retaining fixture is configured to be press fit into the topskin.
19. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 15, wherein the plurality of trays are made of a composite.
20. (Original) The cargo handling system of claim 19, wherein the topskin comprises a metal top surface and a composite structure disposed below the metal top surface.
21. (New) The cargo handling system of claim 15, wherein the topskin is configured to form a contiguous flat floor through a cargo compartment.
